title: Rain Can't Stop the Rock: Smashing Pumpkins and Charli XCX Light Up Lollapalooza!
summary: Have you ever had to choose between two awesome things happening at the same time? That's exactly what fans faced on the second night of Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago's Grant Park. On one side, hometown heroes Smashing Pumpkins were rocking out. On the other, pop star Charli XCX was throwing a giant dance party. And it was raining! But nobody seemed to care. Smashing Pumpkins played songs from their classic album "Mellon Collie and the Infinite Sadness," which turned 30 last year. Then they surprised everyone by bringing out special guests. First, Yungblud joined them to sing "Luna." He said it was "a dream come true." A few songs later, Olivia Rodrigo walked on stage to sing "Thirty-Three" with frontman Billy Corgan. The crowd went wild! It showed how much the Pumpkins have inspired younger musicians. Meanwhile, across the park, Charli XCX was on the T-Mobile stage with dancers and a live band. She was kicking off her tour for her new album "Music, Fashion, Film." She started with a song called "Rock Music" and had everyone singing and dancing in the rain. For her finale, she performed "No One Lasts Forever." The screen flashed the words "Oblivion is freedom" while Charli and her dancers froze like a painting. It was a dramatic, unforgettable ending. So even with four headliners to pick from, the real winner was the audience — soaked but smiling.
why_it_matters: Sometimes you have to choose between two fun activities at the same time, but this concert shows that even with bad weather and tough choices, you can still have an amazing experience.

background_read: Lollapalooza (a massive music festival that started in 1991) brings hundreds of thousands of fans to Chicago every summer to see rock, pop, and hip-hop stars.
Smashing Pumpkins (a rock band formed in Chicago in the late 1980s) are local heroes known for their emotional, guitar-heavy songs, and Billy Corgan is their famous frontman.
Charli XCX (a British pop singer and songwriter who rose to fame in the 2010s) is famous for writing catchy, energetic songs that get people dancing instantly.
Article_Structure: WHO: Smashing Pumpkins with special guests Yungblud and Olivia Rodrigo, and Charli XCX with her dancers.
WHAT: Despite rain, both acts delivered surprising and powerful performances on the second night of the festival.
WHERE: Lollapalooza 2026 in Chicago's Grant Park, on two different stages at the same time.
WHY: Fans had to pick between two headliners, but the energy, surprise guests, and dramatic finales made it a night to remember for everyone who attended.

perspectives.description: Many festival-goers felt they got a once-in-a-lifetime show because of the surprise guests and the dramatic, rainy atmosphere that added to the excitement.
Some fans were sad they couldn't see both Smashing Pumpkins and Charli XCX fully because the two sets overlapped, forcing a hard choice.
The festival schedule is designed to spread crowds and avoid danger, so having hard choices is a normal part of big music events—it happens every year.
